metadata.question: Did the burn scar area within a 3km radius of 45.506013°N, 110.517217°W (the Pine Creek region near the Yellowstone River) increase between mid-August 2012 and mid-September, 2012?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Landsat 7 Collection 2 Level-2 SR (LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2) because 2012 predates Landsat 8/9.
- AOI: 3 km buffer around Point(45.506013, -110.517217).
- Time windows: mid-Aug (2012-08-10 to 2012-08-25) and mid-Sep (2012-09-10 to 2012-09-25). If empty or no valid pixels, widen to month-long windows.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds, cloud shadow, snow, cirrus, dilated, and fill using QA_PIXEL.
- Scale SR reflectance to physical units. Compute NBR = (NIR - SWIR2)/(NIR + SWIR2) on scaled reflectance.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If any collection is empty even after fallback: C1.
- If images exist but after masking no valid pixels: C2.
- If any computed mean NBR or area is null/NaN or outside valid range [-1, 1]: C3.
- Otherwise, compare area with dNBR>0.1 vs dNBR<-0.1 to decide A/B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-110.517217, 45.506013]);
  const aoi = pt.buffer(3000); // 3 km radius
  const scale = 1000; // per instruction: use >=1000m for reduceRegion

  const augStart = '2012-08-10';
  const augEnd = '2012-08-25';
  const sepStart = '2012-09-10';
  const sepEnd = '2012-09-25';

  // 2. Helpers
  function maskL7sr(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 0).eq(0) // fill off
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)) // dilated cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // cirrus
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // cloud shadow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // snow
    const scaled = img.select(['SR_B4', 'SR_B7']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return scaled.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, ['CLOUD_COVER', 'system:time_start']);
  }

  async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo(resolve, reject);
    });
  }

  async function getComposite(start, end, label) {
    // Try initial window
    let colRaw = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end);
    let size = await getInfoAsync(colRaw.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      // Widen to month window around middle
      const startW = ee.Date(start).advance(-10, 'day');
      const endW = ee.Date(end).advance(10, 'day');
      colRaw = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(startW, endW);
      size = await getInfoAsync(colRaw.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        return { label, size: 0, cloudMed: null, nbr: null, validCount: 0, widened: true, c1: true };
      }
    }
    const cloudMed = ee.Number(colRaw.aggregate_median('CLOUD_COVER'));
    const col = colRaw.map(maskL7sr);
    const composite = col.median(); // SR_B4, SR_B7
    const nbr = composite.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B7']).rename('NBR');

    const validMask = nbr.mask();
    const validCount = ee.Number(
      ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(validMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('constant')
    );

    const countVal = await getInfoAsync(validCount);
    if (!countVal || countVal === 0) {
      // Widen further if not already widened
      const startW2 = ee.Date(start).advance(-20, 'day');
      const endW2 = ee.Date(end).advance(20, 'day');
      const colRaw2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(startW2, endW2);
      const size2 = await getInfoAsync(colRaw2.size());
      if (size2 === 0) {
        return { label, size: size, cloudMed: await getInfoAsync(cloudMed), nbr: null, validCount: 0, widened: true, c1: true };
      }
      const cloudMed2 = ee.Number(colRaw2.aggregate_median('CLOUD_COVER'));
      const col2 = colRaw2.map(maskL7sr);
      const composite2 = col2.median();
      const nbr2 = composite2.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B7']).rename('NBR');
      const validCount2 = ee.Number(
        ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(nbr2.mask()).reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: aoi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('constant')
      );
      const countVal2 = await getInfoAsync(validCount2);
      return {
        label,
        size: size2,
        cloudMed: await getInfoAsync(cloudMed2),
        nbr: nbr2,
        validCount: countVal2 || 0,
        widened: true,
        c1: false
      };
    }

    return {
      label,
      size: size,
      cloudMed: await getInfoAsync(cloudMed),
      nbr: nbr,
      validCount: countVal || 0,
      widened: false,
      c1: false
    };
  }

  // 3. Acquire composites
  const aug = await getComposite(augStart, augEnd, 'Aug');
  const sep = await getComposite(sepStart, sepEnd, 'Sep');

  // 4. Empty collection checks
  if (aug.c1 || sep.c1) {
    console.log(`Aug Images: ${aug.size || 0}`);
    console.log(`Sep Images: ${sep.size || 0}`);
    console.log('One or both periods have no images after recovery.');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  // 5. Valid pixels check
  if ((aug.validCount || 0) === 0 || (sep.validCount || 0) === 0) {
    console.log(`Aug Images: ${aug.size} (ValidPix: ${aug.validCount})`);
    console.log(`Sep Images: ${sep.size} (ValidPix: ${sep.validCount})`);
    console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }

  // 6. Calculate NBR means
  const nbrMeanAug = ee.Number(aug.nbr.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: aoi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('NBR'));
  const nbrMeanSep = ee.Number(sep.nbr.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: aoi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('NBR'));

  const nbrMeanAugVal = await getInfoAsync(nbrMeanAug);
  const nbrMeanSepVal = await getInfoAsync(nbrMeanSep);

  // 7. C3 checks on NBR means
  function invalidNumber(x, min, max) {
    return x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x) || !isFinite(x) || x < min || x > max;
  }
  if (invalidNumber(nbrMeanAugVal, -1, 1) || invalidNumber(nbrMeanSepVal, -1, 1)) {
    console.log(`NBR mean Aug: ${nbrMeanAugVal}, Sep: ${nbrMeanSepVal}`);
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  // 8. dNBR and area stats
  const dNBR = aug.nbr.subtract(sep.nbr).rename('dNBR');
  const dNBRMean = ee.Number(dNBR.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: aoi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('dNBR'));
  const dNBRMeanVal = await getInfoAsync(dNBRMean);
  if (invalidNumber(dNBRMeanVal, -2, 2)) {
    console.log(`dNBR mean: ${dNBRMeanVal}`);
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea();
  const posArea = ee.Number(pixelArea.updateMask(dNBR.gt(0.1)).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry: aoi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('area'));
  const negArea = ee.Number(pixelArea.updateMask(dNBR.lt(-0.1)).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry: aoi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('area'));
  const posHa = await getInfoAsync(posArea.divide(10000));
  const negHa = await getInfoAsync(negArea.divide(10000));

  // 9. Print concise evidence
  console.log(`AOI radius: 3km; Scale: ${scale}m`);
  console.log(`Aug Images: ${aug.size} (cloudMed: ${Math.round((aug.cloudMed || 0) * 10) / 10}%), ValidPix: ${aug.validCount}`);
  console.log(`Sep Images: ${sep.size} (cloudMed: ${Math.round((sep.cloudMed || 0) * 10) / 10}%), ValidPix: ${sep.validCount}`);
  console.log(`NBR mean Aug: ${nbrMeanAugVal.toFixed(3)}, Sep: ${nbrMeanSepVal.toFixed(3)}`);
  console.log(`dNBR mean (Aug-Sep): ${dNBRMeanVal.toFixed(3)}`);
  console.log(`Area dNBR>0.1: ${Number(posHa || 0).toFixed(2)} ha, dNBR<-0.1: ${Number(negHa || 0).toFixed(2)} ha`);

  // 10. Final decision
  // Consider increase if positive dNBR area exceeds negative by >1 ha and pos area > 1 ha
  const increased = (posHa || 0) > Math.max(1, (negHa || 0) + 1);
  console.log(increased ? 'A' : 'B');
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
